name: represent a moving boundary as the zero level of an evolving field
mechanism: instead of tracking boundary points, store a field over the whole grid whose zero contour is the boundary; evolve the field by a speed equation and read the boundary off wherever the field crosses zero, so merging and splitting need no special handling

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Level set method (LSM)' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Geometric: a numerical technique for tracking interfaces and shapes

requires: a grid over the whole domain
periodic re-initialisation to a distance field
fails_when: one dimension more storage than the boundary itself; the field drifts from a distance function
